personality.description: This person tends to follow their own interests, trying new things selectively while still preferring familiar routines that feel safe and manageable. In daily habits, they are often spontaneous and flexible, but they can also be disorganized, forgetful, and inconsistent about finishing tasks on time. When facing moral dilemmas, they usually approach them with caution and suspicion, weighing how each choice affects their own goals and worrying about hidden risks or unfairness, which can make them hesitate or second-guess themselves. In group discussions, they are typically quiet and reserved, speaking in short, guarded statements and becoming more pointed or argumentative if they feel challenged, especially under stress.
